sql: WITH t0 AS (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS t), r AS (SELECT (WITH allowed AS ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.logo_url, c.parent_id FROM companies c WHERE true OR c.id = ANY (public.get_user_company_ids(auth.uid())) ), scope_all AS ( SELECT * FROM allowed WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT * FROM allowed WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM allowed WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL) ), scope AS ( SELECT * FROM scope_all WHERE NULL::uuid IS NULL OR id = NULL::uuid ), bounds AS ( SELECT (now() - interval '90 days') - (now() - (now() - interval '90 days')) AS prev_from ), leads AS ( SELECT l.company_id, l.status::text AS status, l.created_at FROM campaign_leads l, bounds b WHERE l.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND l.created_at >= b.prev_from AND l.created_at <= now() AND (NULL::text IS NULL OR l.status::text = NULL::text) ), cur_leads AS ( SELECT * FROM leads WHERE created_at >= (now() - interval '90 days') ), lead_stats AS ( SELECT company_id, count(*) AS leads, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS leads_today, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'novo') AS leads_new, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'perdido') AS leads_lost, max(created_at) AS last_lead_at FROM cur_leads GROUP BY company_id ), closed AS ( SELECT e.company_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.data_fechamento_venda >= (now() - interval '90 days')::date AND e.data_fechamento_venda <= now()::date) AS closed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.data_fechamento_venda < (now() - interval '90 days')::date) AS closed_prev FROM company_events e, bounds b WHERE e.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND e.data_fechamento_venda >= b.prev_from::date AND e.data_fechamento_venda <= now()::date GROUP BY e.company_id ), convos AS ( SELECT company_id, count(*) AS conversations, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT coalesce(is_closed, false)) AS active_conversations FROM wapi_conversations WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND created_at >= (now() - interval '90 days') AND created_at <= now() GROUP BY company_id ), follow_ups AS ( SELECT company_id, count(*) AS follow_ups FROM lead_history WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND action ILIKE 'Follow-up%' AND created_at >= (now() - interval '90 days') AND created_at <= now() GROUP BY company_id ), msgs AS ( SELECT company_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE from_me) AS msgs_sent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT from_me) AS msgs_received FROM wapi_messages WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND created_at >= (now() - interval '90 days') AND created_at <= now() GROUP BY company_id ), recent_convos AS ( SELECT id, company_id, created_at FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.company_id, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.company_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM wapi_conversations c WHERE c.company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) AND c.created_at >= (now() - interval '90 days') AND c.created_at <= now() ) x WHERE rn <= 100 ), responses AS ( SELECT rc.company_id, extract(epoch FROM (fm.ts - rc.created_at)) / 60 AS minutes FROM recent_convos rc CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(m.timestamp) AS ts FROM wapi_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = rc.id AND m.from_me AND m.metadata->>'source' IN ('platform', 'phone') ) fm WHERE fm.ts IS NOT NULL AND fm.ts >= rc.created_at AND fm.ts < rc.created_at + interval '30 days' ), response_stats AS ( SELECT company_id, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes) AS median_minutes, count(*) AS samples FROM responses GROUP BY company_id ), instances AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (company_id) company_id, status, phone_number FROM wapi_instances WHERE company_id IN (SELECT id FROM scope) ORDER BY company_id, connected_at DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'companies_all', coalesce(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name) ORDER BY name) FROM scope_all ), '[]'::jsonb), 'companies', coalesce(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'logo_url', s.logo_url, 'whatsapp_status', CASE WHEN i.status IN ('open', 'connected') THEN 'connected' WHEN i.company_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'disconnected' ELSE 'unknown' END, 'whatsapp_phone', i.phone_number, 'leads', coalesce(ls.leads, 0), 'leads_today', coalesce(ls.leads_today, 0), 'leads_new', coalesce(ls.leads_new, 0), 'leads_lost', coalesce(ls.leads_lost, 0), 'last_lead_at', ls.last_lead_at, 'closed', coalesce(cl.closed, 0), 'conversations', coalesce(cv.conversations, 0), 'active_conversations', coalesce(cv.active_conversations, 0), 'follow_ups', coalesce(fu.follow_ups, 0), 'msgs_sent', coalesce(ms.msgs_sent, 0), 'msgs_received', coalesce(ms.msgs_received, 0), 'response_median_minutes', rs.median_minutes, 'response_samples', coalesce(rs.samples, 0) ) ORDER BY s.name) FROM scope s LEFT JOIN lead_stats ls ON ls.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN closed cl ON cl.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN convos cv ON cv.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN follow_ups fu ON fu.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN msgs ms ON ms.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN response_stats rs ON rs.company_id = s.id LEFT JOIN instances i ON i.company_id = s.id ), '[]'::jsonb), 'previous', jsonb_build_object( 'leads', (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at < (now() - interval '90 days')), 'closed', (SELECT coalesce(sum(closed_prev), 0) FROM closed) ), 'response', jsonb_build_object( 'median_minutes', (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY minutes) FROM responses), 'samples', (SELECT count(*) FROM responses) ), 'lead_buckets', coalesce(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('company_id', company_id, 'month', month, 'status', status, 'count', n)) FROM ( SELECT company_id, to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'YYYY-MM') AS month, status, count(*) AS n FROM cur_leads GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) b ), '[]'::jsonb) )) AS j FROM t0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('ms', extract(milliseconds FROM clock_timestamp() - (SELECT t FROM t0)), 'response', j->'response', 'companies', (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n', c->'name', 'med', c->'response_median_minutes', 's', c->'response_samples', 'conv', c->'conversations')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(j->'companies') c)) AS out FROM r
